answer_1.quote: The task of automatically generating consultation notes from clinician-patient interactions is rapidly gaining interest in the research community.
datasets: proprietary Babylon dataset of 10,000 transcripts and consultation notes

answer_2.quote: Overlap an indication of how much of the final note comes from the system. This is estimated with ROUGE-L ) recall 6 , which measures the n-gram overlap between generated and final notes divided by the n-gram count in the final note.

answer_4.quote: Some of the Note Generation studies include an intrinsic human evaluation of the generated consultation notes to measure common Natural Language Generation (NLG) criteria such as accuracy, fluency, and completeness
answer_4.guideline: measure common Natural Language Generation (NLG) criteria such as accuracy, fluency, and completeness
